newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia appoints lead managers for D-mark Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Croatia appoints lead managers for D-mark Eurobond.

text.p: Croatia said on Wednesday it appointed Credit Suisse First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to lead its debut Eurobond offering in German marks.
"Timing, size and maturity of the issue will be made officially known shortly prior to the launch of the transaction," the Finance Ministry said in a news release.
It said the ministry officials would present Croatia to investors in "key financial centres", but gave no details of when the roadshow would be launched.
Croatia said recently it envisaged the mark Eurobonds in mid-year. It alos planned to raise 300-500 million kuna through a Eurodomestic bond issue sometime in autumn.
The sovereign debt is rated Baa3 by Moody's Investor Service and BBB- by Standard & Poor's and IBCA. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
